topStories.headline: US Military Intercepts Iranian Attack; WTI Crude Surges ~5% to $83+
topStories.summary: The US military announced it successfully intercepted an Iranian 'attempted surprise attack' on US troops in the Middle East, reigniting geopolitical tensions after several days of calm and driving a sharp move in energy markets.
topStories.marketImpact: WTI crude ↑ ~5% to $83+; US equity-index futures ↓; energy stocks ↑; safe-haven flows into gold and Treasuries

topStories.headline: AI Capex Fears Fuel US Chip Selloff; Micron Down 4%+, AMD Down 3%+, Nvidia Down 1.2% Premarket
topStories.summary: Semiconductor stocks face renewed selling pressure as investors question whether hyperscalers — now potentially sitting on excess GPU capacity — are approaching an inflection point that could unwind the AI scarcity thesis driving valuations.
topStories.marketImpact: MU ↓ 4%+ premarket; AMD ↓ 3%+; NVDA ↓ 1.2%; INTC ↓ 3%+; Semiconductor Index already off 20% from June peak

topStories.headline: FOMC Decision Day: Fed Widely Expected to Hold at 3.50–3.75%; Warsh Speaks at 2:30 PM ET
topStories.summary: The Fed's two-day July meeting concludes today with markets pricing ~85% probability of a hold; the updated dot plot shown in June put the median year-end 2026 rate at 3.8% with 9 of 18 officials pencilling at least one hike — today's presser is the key watch.
topStories.marketImpact: Hawkish tone → yields ↑, equities ↓; any dovish pivot surprise → TLT ↑, QQQ ↑; no new dot plot released at this meeting

topStories.headline: UPS Beats Q2 Estimates, Raises Full-Year Revenue Guidance to $91.2B
topStories.summary: UPS reported Q2 revenue of $22.8B (vs. $21.81B estimate) and adjusted EPS of $1.76 (vs. $1.66 estimate), raising its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $91.2B and adjusted EPS to ~$7.22.
topStories.marketImpact: UPS ↑ premarket; a rare positive catalyst in today's risk-off session; signals resilient logistics demand despite macro headwinds

topStories.headline: Visa Cuts 2,600 Jobs — 7% of Workforce — in AI-Driven Efficiency Push
topStories.summary: CEO Ryan McInerney announced a workforce reduction primarily targeting technology and product teams, citing AI tools that now handle routine tasks; freed capital will be redirected toward stablecoin, B2B, and cross-border payment products.
topStories.marketImpact: V near-term sentiment ↓; longer-term strategic pivot to high-growth verticals; read-across to MA as sector AI-efficiency narrative deepens

topStories.headline: Zhongji Innolight Raises $6.81B in Hong Kong's Largest AI-Infrastructure IPO in Nearly Seven Years
topStories.summary: The Chinese optical transceiver maker priced at HK$980/share, raising HK$53.4 billion — Asia's second-largest IPO of 2026 — backed by Temasek, BlackRock, Hillhouse, Alibaba, and Tencent; Q1 net profit nearly quadrupled YoY; trading begins July 30.
topStories.marketImpact: 3308.HK debut tomorrow ↑ watch; strong cornerstone investor lineup signals sustained institutional appetite for AI infrastructure despite sector volatility

topStories.headline: Shein Targets Late-August Hong Kong IPO at $40–50B Despite Q1 Net Loss of $99M
topStories.summary: Shein disclosed a Q1 2026 net loss driven by US de minimis tariff changes and European import fees, targeting a Hong Kong listing as early as late August at a valuation sharply below its 2023 peak of ~$100B.
topStories.marketImpact: Fast-fashion and cross-border e-commerce tariff exposure ↓; valuation reset signals IPO market is demanding hard fundamental anchoring

topStories.headline: Nikkei Plunges 3.95% to Two-Month Low as Japanese Chip Stocks Crater
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 fell to 62,365 led by semiconductor-linked names, with Kioxia Holdings (285A.T) down 18.3%, Advantest (6857.T) down 10.1%, and Tokyo Electron (8035.T) down 11%; banking stocks also weakened.

topStories.headline: Big Asia Funds Rotate Out of AI Chip Trades, Into Diversified Laggards
topStories.summary: Major Asia asset managers including M&G and Eastspring are trimming overweight AI and Taiwan positions, rotating into Indonesian banks, Chinese e-commerce, and Indian tech firms to reduce AI-cycle concentration risk.
topStories.marketImpact: 9988.HK (Alibaba) and regional diversified plays ↑ relative; Taiwan and AI-linked names see incremental outflows ↓

companiesToWatch.name: Meta Platforms
companiesToWatch.reason: Reports Q2 earnings after close today; AI capex guidance is the single most closely watched datapoint for the entire chip complex — any scale-back would deepen the semiconductor selloff.

companiesToWatch.name: Microsoft
companiesToWatch.reason: Reports Q2 earnings after close today alongside Meta; Azure AI growth rate and forward cloud capex commentary will set the tone for the AI infrastructure debate.

companiesToWatch.name: Micron Technology
companiesToWatch.reason: Down 4%+ premarket as the global chip selloff extends to the US; the stock surged ~884% over the past year on AI memory demand, making it a prime crowded-trade unwind target.

companiesToWatch.name: UPS
companiesToWatch.reason: Clean Q2 beat on both revenue and EPS plus raised full-year guidance — a rare positive catalyst in today's risk-off session.

companiesToWatch.name: Visa
companiesToWatch.reason: Announced 2,600 job cuts (7% of workforce) targeting tech and product teams, reinforcing the AI-driven headcount compression trend across financial services.

companiesToWatch.name: SoftBank Group
companiesToWatch.reason: Fell 4.4% in today's Nikkei rout; as a heavily leveraged AI investment vehicle its share price serves as a real-time proxy for global AI capex sentiment.
